sloka: बलवन्तश्च कच्चित्ते मुख्या युद्धविशारदा: ।दृष्टापदाना विक्रान्तास्त्वया सत्कृत्य मानिता: ॥ २.१००.३२॥
transliteration: balavantaśca kaccitte mukhyā yuddhaviśāradā: ।dṛṣṭāpadānā vikrāntāstvayā satkṛtya mānitā: ॥ 2.100.32॥

translations.english: I trust you distribute rations and wages to your army in due time without making delay.
